landing.title: Where licensed businesses change hands
landing.subtitle: Sellers list regulated assets. Buyers publish an acquisition mandate. The platform matches the two and keeps the conversation in one place.
landing.demoTitle: Sign in as a demo user
landing.demoSubtitle: One click, no password to type. Each account is seeded with data so every flow works immediately.
landing.roleSellerBlurb: Publish and manage listings, search buyer mandates, start a conversation.
landing.roleBuyerBlurb: Describe what you are looking for, filter the catalogue, contact a seller.
landing.roleManagerBlurb: Review participants and listings, suspend or remove with a reason, read the audit log.
